text: No, not all days were checked in the initial assessment. The first analysis (version 1) only covered October 1–7, 2026, due to delays in near-real-time data updates for October 7–8. However, the second analysis (version 2) confirmed full coverage for all days (October 1–8) across all sensors (VIIRS SNPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, and MODIS). No thermal detections were found in either assessment.
